item.title: Armenia puts Church leader on trial for allegedly being a Russian spy

item.description: Rulings allow Trump administration to end Temporary Protected Status for nationals of the two countries.

item.title: Trump shifts blame to Republicans for waning support from public
item.description: Republican senators are using the summer recess to avoid politically difficult votes.

item.title: Colombia’s new president takes office vowing to ‘crush’ narco-terrorism
